summary: EDHOC is a compact, lightweight authenticated Diffie-Hellman key exchange using ephemeral keys. It provides mutual authentication, forward secrecy, and identity protection. It is meant for constrained scenarios, such as setting up an OSCORE security context. It reuses COSE for cryptography, CBOR for encoding, and CoAP for transport.

eli5.summary: Two tiny gadgets want to agree on a secret handshake without shouting it. EDHOC lets them do so in only a few small messages and prove who they are.

questions: lightweight authenticated key exchange for iot
